name: Gutted tug
text: Someone got here first. The tug's been picked over by people in a hurry, and people in a hurry miss things.

outcomes.result: Under a deck plate: a part, still in its wrapping.
Nothing but cut wiring and a strongly worded note. Some loose change, at least.

choices.label: Raid the galley
choices.result: Half a pallet of ration packs, only slightly past their date.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.result: Whoever picked it over can have the rest.
